questions.question: What did Daniel see in his vision of chapter 7?
options: Four great beasts coming up out of the sea
A great statue of gold, silver, and iron clay
A river of fire pouring from a throne
A lampstand flanked by two olive trees
questions.answer: Four great beasts coming up out of the sea

questions.question: Who is described as coming with the clouds of heaven and given everlasting dominion?
options: One like a son of man
questions.answer: One like a son of man

questions.question: In the vision the Ancient of Days took his seat and the court sat in judgment.
Behold, with the clouds of heaven there came one like a son of _____.
His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass _____.
